composite.conditions: Last-axis FP32. Serial rows, passes and tiles. Balanced binary reduction levels wait for predecessors; partials merge into one row state. ascend.conditions: HBM 与 UB 同时预约的 DMA 取两端最小服务率。输入 DMA、UB 操作数读取、计算、UB 结果写入、导出 DMA 分阶段串行，L2 bypass。每次算子调用为冷启动。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

tpu.conditions: HBM 按 TensorCore 数均分，VMEM 为单核共享服务。输入 DMA、操作数读取、计算、结果写入、导出 DMA 分阶段串行；CMEM bypass。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

tsp.conditions: 完整输入和输出驻留所选本侧 MEM。每个输入读取受 MEM 和输入 stream 共同约束；输出写回受 MEM 和输出 stream 共同约束。FP32/INT32 每元素 4 byte，stream 每块按完整宽度补齐，MEM 只计逻辑载荷。使用一个共享 VXM 任务预算，CIM 不复制预算。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

assumptions: INT8 input and INT32 accumulator/output follow the project convention; no TPU numerical emulation.
Logical input tiles are read once from VMEM and ideally shared across MXUs; no fanout traffic; input panels are reused within each CMEM outer tile.
Padding is implicit inside the array proxy; no extra padded VMEM allocation or physical action counts are claimed.
Old C seeds matrix accumulation across K; MAC service includes the addition, with explicit VMEM partial-sum read/write stages.
This is an uncalibrated estimate, not a real-hardware upper/lower bound; configured assumed services are not measured hardware bandwidths.
Two input slots enable next-K prefetch during compute when capacity permits; VMEM transfers share one service. Output blocks remain serialized; no bank conflicts or XLA scheduling.

Cold CMEM holds full-K A/B panels in one or two capacity-checked slots. Each panel is completely filled before its first read. Pipeline scheduling permits next-panel fill alongside inner execution, and releases a slot after its last CMEM read. Fills and output exports share one non-preemptive HBM service; a refill that cannot finish before the current export is ready is deferred until after that export. Serial scheduling disables these overlaps. CMEM read and write services are independent across different live slots; each DMA reserves both endpoints once at their minimum rate. C stays in VMEM across K and exports directly to HBM. No cross-outer retention, partial-fill consumption, physical layout/coalescing, OCI or bank-conflict model; transfer_startup uses the common explicit allowance.

execution_contract.source: Project analytical execution policy; ARCHITECTURE.md execution contract
execution_contract.conditions: Explicit analytical policies, not measured hardware behavior. CMEM starts cold with full-K A/B panels for at most cmem_groups_mn VMEM output blocks. Preserve the selected panel shape; use two slots only when capacity and remaining panels allow, otherwise one. Capacity and bandwidth are equally partitioned between TensorCores with no borrowing. If one panel does not fit, shrink groups, then report bypass if necessary. Resource-pipeline scheduling overlaps next-panel fills with inner execution and releases CMEM slots after their last input read. HBM fills and exports share one non-preemptive service; late refills are deferred until after the current output export. CMEM read and write services are independent across different live slots. Each DMA reserves both endpoints once at the minimum rate plus transfer_startup. Serial mode disables overlap. VMEM retains C across K with one or two input slots; inner output blocks remain serial. No partial-fill consumption, cross-outer/task retention, OCI/bank conflicts, physical layout or XLA mapping. CLI/API overrides, effective mode and slot counts are reported.

assumptions: INT8 input and INT32 accumulator/output follow the project convention; no TPU numerical emulation.
Logical input tiles are read once from VMEM and ideally shared across MXUs; no fanout traffic; input panels are reused within each CMEM outer tile.
Padding is implicit inside the array proxy; no extra padded VMEM allocation or physical action counts are claimed.
Old C seeds matrix accumulation across K; MAC service includes the addition, with explicit VMEM partial-sum read/write stages.
This is an uncalibrated estimate, not a real-hardware upper/lower bound; configured assumed services are not measured hardware bandwidths.
Two input slots enable next-K prefetch during compute when capacity permits; VMEM transfers share one service. Output blocks remain serialized; no bank conflicts or XLA scheduling.

Cold CMEM holds full-K A/B panels in one or two capacity-checked slots. Each panel is completely filled before its first read. Pipeline scheduling permits next-panel fill alongside inner execution, and releases a slot after its last CMEM read. Fills and output exports share one non-preemptive HBM service; a refill that cannot finish before the current export is ready is deferred until after that export. Serial scheduling disables these overlaps. CMEM read and write services are independent across different live slots; each DMA reserves both endpoints once at their minimum rate. C stays in VMEM across K and exports directly to HBM. No cross-outer retention, partial-fill consumption, physical layout/coalescing, OCI or bank-conflict model; transfer_startup uses the common explicit allowance.

execution_contract.source: Project analytical execution policy; ARCHITECTURE.md execution contract
execution_contract.conditions: Explicit analytical policies, not measured hardware behavior. CMEM starts cold with full-K A/B panels for at most cmem_groups_mn VMEM output blocks. Preserve the selected panel shape; use two slots only when capacity and remaining panels allow, otherwise one. Capacity and bandwidth are equally partitioned between TensorCores with no borrowing. If one panel does not fit, shrink groups, then report bypass if necessary. Resource-pipeline scheduling overlaps next-panel fills with inner execution and releases CMEM slots after their last input read. HBM fills and exports share one non-preemptive service; late refills are deferred until after the current output export. CMEM read and write services are independent across different live slots. Each DMA reserves both endpoints once at the minimum rate plus transfer_startup. Serial mode disables overlap. VMEM retains C across K with one or two input slots; inner output blocks remain serial. No partial-fill consumption, cross-outer/task retention, OCI/bank conflicts, physical layout or XLA mapping. CLI/API overrides, effective mode and slot counts are reported.

assumptions: INT8 input and INT32 accumulator/output follow the project convention; no TPU numerical emulation.
Logical input tiles are read once from VMEM and ideally shared across MXUs; no fanout traffic; input panels are reused within each CMEM outer tile.
Padding is implicit inside the array proxy; no extra padded VMEM allocation or physical action counts are claimed.
Old C seeds matrix accumulation across K; MAC service includes the addition, with explicit VMEM partial-sum read/write stages.
This is an uncalibrated estimate, not a real-hardware upper/lower bound; configured assumed services are not measured hardware bandwidths.
Two input slots enable next-K prefetch during compute when capacity permits; VMEM transfers share one service. Output blocks remain serialized; no bank conflicts or XLA scheduling.

Cold CMEM holds full-K A/B panels in one or two capacity-checked slots. Each panel is completely filled before its first read. Pipeline scheduling permits next-panel fill alongside inner execution, and releases a slot after its last CMEM read. Fills and output exports share one non-preemptive HBM service; a refill that cannot finish before the current export is ready is deferred until after that export. Serial scheduling disables these overlaps. CMEM read and write services are independent across different live slots; each DMA reserves both endpoints once at their minimum rate. C stays in VMEM across K and exports directly to HBM. No cross-outer retention, partial-fill consumption, physical layout/coalescing, OCI or bank-conflict model; transfer_startup uses the common explicit allowance.

execution_contract.source: Project analytical execution policy; ARCHITECTURE.md execution contract
execution_contract.conditions: Explicit analytical policies, not measured hardware behavior. CMEM starts cold with full-K A/B panels for at most cmem_groups_mn VMEM output blocks. Preserve the selected panel shape; use two slots only when capacity and remaining panels allow, otherwise one. Capacity and bandwidth are equally partitioned between TensorCores with no borrowing. If one panel does not fit, shrink groups, then report bypass if necessary. Resource-pipeline scheduling overlaps next-panel fills with inner execution and releases CMEM slots after their last input read. HBM fills and exports share one non-preemptive service; late refills are deferred until after the current output export. CMEM read and write services are independent across different live slots. Each DMA reserves both endpoints once at the minimum rate plus transfer_startup. Serial mode disables overlap. VMEM retains C across K with one or two input slots; inner output blocks remain serial. No partial-fill consumption, cross-outer/task retention, OCI/bank conflicts, physical layout or XLA mapping. CLI/API overrides, effective mode and slot counts are reported.

hbm_bandwidth_bytes_per_second.conditions: Published aggregate bandwidth, decimal GB/s; no inference of single-TensorCore effective bandwidth.

schedule.head_binding: Each (batch, query head) shares that batch's latent/positional cache; head-specific K/V weight sections are shared across batches.
schedule.order: Append once, execute the complete template per batch/query head serially, then optionally project all contexts. Repetition counts summarize serial work.

attention_execution_profile.conditions: Single-token Decode with uniform cache lengths. INT8 what-if storage, FP32 scale/Softmax. Preallocated per-KV-head backing is shared; each query head rereads K/V using native GEMM, with no physical repeat or transpose instruction. Q/K/V projection, position processing, output projection, cache eviction and chip execution are outside this block.

block_execution_profile.conditions: Single core/TensorCore/hemisphere. Native GEMM padding views share symbolic backing allocations. INT8 storage and FP32 nonlinear work; materialized outputs. No physical layout, quantization instruction or numerical accuracy claim.

to_fp32_cost.conditions: Coarse storage-boundary conversion work; no standalone instruction model.

to_int8_cost.conditions: Coarse scale/round/clamp work proxy; no numerical quantization or standalone instruction model.

fp32_rcp_cost.conditions: Reciprocal work proxy on the shared Vector/VXM budget.

ascend.conditions: HBM 与 UB 同时预约的 DMA 取两端最小服务率。输入 DMA、UB 操作数读取、计算、UB 结果写入、导出 DMA 分阶段串行，L2 bypass。每次算子调用为冷启动。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

tpu.conditions: HBM 按 TensorCore 数均分，VMEM 为单核共享服务。输入 DMA、操作数读取、计算、结果写入、导出 DMA 分阶段串行；CMEM bypass。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

tsp.conditions: 完整输入和输出驻留所选本侧 MEM。每个输入读取受 MEM 和输入 stream 共同约束；输出写回受 MEM 和输出 stream 共同约束。FP32/INT32 每元素 4 byte，stream 每块按完整宽度补齐，MEM 只计逻辑载荷。使用一个共享 VXM 任务预算，CIM 不复制预算。 分块上限 1024 为确定性策略；显式零启动开销表示未建模固定延迟，不表示实测零延迟。无跨块重叠、广播、归约、转换或原地更新。

ascend_ub_read_bpc.conditions: 每周期 64 个 32-bit 字作为独立 UB 端口服务代理：64*4=256 B/cycle。参考现有 Vector 预算量级选择，不是实测 UB 带宽；数值固定，不随 compute budget 修改。读写分阶段串行，DMA 同时预约 HBM 和 UB。

ascend_ub_write_bpc.conditions: 每周期 64 个 32-bit 字作为独立 UB 端口服务代理：64*4=256 B/cycle。参考现有 Vector 预算量级选择，不是实测 UB 带宽；数值固定，不随 compute budget 修改。读写分阶段串行，DMA 同时预约 HBM 和 UB。

composite.conditions: Last-axis FP32. Serial rows, passes and tiles. Balanced binary reduction levels wait for predecessors; partials merge into one row state. Constants are implicit; one scalar read per tile broadcasts without extra shuffle work. RMSNorm rereads x and loads weight per row. Softmax stores exp in the output allocation, then normalizes it. No numerical accuracy or hardware-instruction claims.

fp32_sub_cost.conditions: One scalar SUB modeled as one basic equivalent operation; shares native Vector/VXM budget, not calibrated.

fp32_max_cost.conditions: One pairwise MAX comparison/selection modeled as one equivalent operation; not calibrated.

fp32_rcp_cost.conditions: Algorithmic proxy: one seed-equivalent operation plus two Newton-style updates of two MUL and one SUB each: 1+2*3=7. Seed accuracy and numerical result are not modeled; not native reciprocal timing.

reduction_round_cycles.conditions: Minimum compute dependency interval per tree level or cross-tile binary merge. Total compute is max(weighted-work cycles, this value); memory and startup charged separately. Not a measured shuffle or lane-network latency.

limitations: INT8 performance what-if with explicit conversions; no numerical quantization accuracy claim.
Preprocessing and table generation are separate. Uniform-length one-token Decode; position equals the newest cached token.
K/V weight partitions, cache transposes and concatenated contexts use symbolic padded views; no physical repacking/ISA model.
Cache capacity is shared, but native cold-cache reads repeat per query head. No extra standalone cache scan.
Scale multiplier is explicit caller input (for example a squared YaRN mscale); no inferred context-extension policy.
Single core/TensorCore/hemisphere; no paging, eviction, chip partition, inter-head overlap, MoE or full-model execution.

io_contract.name_scope: Within one operator call; graph callers must qualify names by node identity.
io_contract.intermediate_residency: No UB/VMEM/register retention across operator calls is promised.
io_contract.conversion: No implicit cast, dequantization or requantization; stored dtype is binding.
io_contract.traffic: Standalone actions already include each block's boundary accesses; connections do not remove them.
